{{Infobox auto}}

A '''brownie''' is a [[chocolate]] meal that heals {{Value|Brownie|heals}} and grants {{EffectLink|Haste}} {{Value|Brownie|level|effect=Haste}} for 2 minutes 30 seconds.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/brownie.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
2 chocolate, sugar and dough. Obtaining chocolate unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating a brownie takes {{Value|Brownie|eat_time}}, heals {{Value|Brownie|heals}} and gives Haste {{Value|Brownie|level|effect=Haste}} for {{Value|Brownie|duration|effect=Haste|format=clock}}.

=== Trading ===
{{Upcoming|type=section}}
It is one of the foods a villager will be able to ask for as its [[favorite food]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/favorite_food/food_trades/food_3.mcfunction|at=5bf7c3e22adaabf2416c83b709842cb9a053cb95}}</ref>
